label: About
title: About Light Loses Count
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 4 recent saved-signal files and 3 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @neural_divine: Abstract luminous data-art. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Light Loses Count: Landscape optical abstraction: one dominant black dot-lattice island and a smaller detached island in open violet-blue light. Two disconnected looping clusters of lavender ribbon lobes bloom cyan-white across a quiet interval. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Near-black left island with an irregular stepped perimeter and rows of cyan, mint, yellow, and orange marks and Large black dot-and-dash island at the left edge.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
